decisions.reason: Although publicly presented, this superfood drink mix is comparatively peripheral to the firm's core industrial sustainability and plant-engineering trajectory, so escalation of commitment is weaker and management is more likely to reallocate resources.

As a modular extension line within the firm's established waste-to-energy business, it likely carries substantial engineering investment, visible commitment and strong strategic fit, which favors continued support despite any mixed results.
This waste-oil-to-energy plant sits squarely in the firm's core technological mission and had sustained standalone website visibility, making management likely to justify and continue the investment.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the established offer and publicly highlighted, so sunk development costs and strategic relevance should keep it on the market, though with more uncertainty than the firm's most established core plant products.
